name: ShowHiddenChannels
author: JustOptimize (Oggetto)
description: A plugin which displays all hidden Channels and allows users to view information about them, this won't allow you to read them (impossible).

changelog.title: v6.14 - Discord Update
items: Fixed the hidden channel lock icon and role pills missing after a Discord update.

changelog.title: v6.13 - Discord Dispatcher Update
items: Fixed the plugin failing to load after Discord's dispatcher update (#291).

changelog.title: v6.12 - Native Channel Header
items: Hidden channels now keep Discord's real header, so the channel topic and its See More expander show again (fixes the missing-topic regression from the GUILD_APP update).
Only the message area, the call view and the members sidebar are swapped for the lock screen; the header toolbar is trimmed to just the mute button.
Fixed the lock screen not centering on hidden voice channels.
Forum channels are labelled correctly instead of "unknown", and hidden spoiler channels now say so.
Refreshed dead Discord CSS variables so the permissions and forum panels have their background and text back.
